description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ethical principles addressed within the MedEthicsQA dataset. The chart contains 16 slices, each representing a different ethical consideration. Slices are labeled as follows: “Recognize the Health and Public Education” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Comply with Laws and Regulations” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Provide Medical Care to Patients” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Continual Learning” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Respect Life, Dignity of Patients” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Give Top Priority to Patient’s Interest” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Minimizing Conflicts of Interest” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Maintain Confidentiality of Patient’s Information” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Keep Patient’s Information Truthful, Factual” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Maintain Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve” (light blue), approximately 6%; “Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain” (light blue), approximately 6%; and “Justice” (orange), approximately 12%. A legend is provided to the left of the chart, identifying each principle and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise around the circle, with no immediately apparent ordering based on size.
